title: The Rain and the Train
lines: Today is a gray, wet day.
Ray can not play in the rain.
He has to stay in all day.
Then Dad hands him a train set.
Ray paints the train gray and red.
He sets it on the main hall rug.
The train can go a long way.
Ray plays with it all day.
Then the rain stops at last.
But Ray will stay in and play.
The train is the best way today.

questions.ask: Why could Ray not play outside?
questions.listenFor: It was a gray, wet day and it was raining. The first two lines hold the answer.

questions.ask: What did Ray do with the train set?
questions.listenFor: He painted it gray and red, then ran it on the main hall rug. Two things, so listen for both.

questions.ask: Why do you think Ray stayed in after the rain stopped?
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. The last line hints he liked the train best, but a child may have their own idea.
